reply_text:
I saved PD-5302 in GBrain as a follow-up ticket for Marrow Fieldworks from the week of 12 Oct 2026, with Hollis's message as the source. GBrain didn't have it before. I also replied to Hollis in their #central-random thread to say it's noted and nothing else is needed.

Two limits:
- **Only Hollis can see it.** It went into Hollis's private memory page, so other members won't find it if they search GBrain.
- **Exact duplicates only.** GBrain has no embedding provider set up. If the same ticket is noted again in different words, it will be saved twice.

GBrain also reported that the server's starter tool setup blocks 98 operations on this connection. That didn't affect this task. Only the brain owner can change it, by running `gbrain doctor --only grant_new_ops_available --json` on the brain host.
